text.tspan: Models propose. The control plane authorizes. Destinations prove effects.
Every surface may capture intent and show review.
No surface owns canonical candidate state.
Capability Broker · the only effect boundary
Resolve scoped capability → preview exact diff → collect approval →
re-check policy at execution → call adapter → verify destination observation
Canonical rule: evidence and confirmed state live in the domain database; models, channels, workflows and agents are replaceable adapters.
